review_scope: Private R2024 two-test candidate; independent source, exact bytes, existing build/runtime logs and command receipts. Root owns adoption and push.

semantic_review.unset_override: Only var_os(MIXER_NODE)==None enters lazy or_else PATH discovery. Empty/missing PATH and relative/empty PATH entries cannot supply an absolute node candidate.
semantic_review.explicit_override: Some(OsString) never falls back, including empty, nonexistent, relative or non-Unicode values. Every explicit path still must be absolute and an existing file.
semantic_review.non_unicode: OS-native non-Unicode values are preserved by var_os/PathBuf, never treated as unset. A valid absolute existing non-Unicode path remains allowed as before; invalid values fail path validation. Non-Unicode case selectors reject before Node discovery.
semantic_review.worker_pinning: Workers use current_exe, explicit current_dir, --ignored --exact TEST --nocapture --test-threads=1, and one canonical CASE_ENV selector. Exactly one consuming case per selected child; no separately discoverable worker test. Node itself is rediscovered from the inherited environment per worker, not parent-pinned by MIXER_NODE.
semantic_review.safe_command: Command::new receives an absolute OS-native node path, fixed -e and ORACLE argv, and module bytes over stdin; no shell interpolation. NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_PATH are removed only for Node child as before. PATH is cleared only for missing-Node negative worker.
semantic_review.prerequisite_order: Selector and node_path validation precede module construction. Node spawn, success, empty stderr and independent expected output precede Mixer validation/admission and execution. Non-executable existing files still fail at Node launch; no Mixer admission follows.
semantic_review.unchanged_contracts: Case arrays, numeric module builders, ORACLE strings, worker argv/selector code, capability grants, default budgets, cleanup and parity assertions are byte-exact outside the two helpers and one missing-Node PATH assignment per test.
semantic_review.failure_diagnosis: Existing complete job131703890662 at7524ffc3ab9094d81dae6805767d88859cccc979 proves missing MIXER_NODE rejection before this parent creates modules or VM state despite available Node. Earlier job131684332631 at59f62941e was not independently retrieved by producer or reviewer.

limitations: No fresh Rust compilation, test-binary execution, Node invocation, complete VM suite or release validation in this review.
Existing debug runtime proof is Rust1.99.0/macOS/Node22.23.3; CI Rust1.99.1/Linux/Node22.23.4 and release ignored execution remain pending.

Empty/non-Unicode override and relative-PATH semantics reviewed from exact source; existing 28 controls cover five invalid selectors, missing Node and relative explicit override, not a runtime matrix of all override/PATH forms.

Discovery checks absolute existing files, not executable permissions, binary provenance, Node version or immutable inode identity; these are preexisting launch/trust limits, not new production qualification.
Canonical adoption, push, CI completion and GA gates are outside this delegated review.
